memory_update.text: TTMI should be tracked as the cleanest US-listed advanced PCB/interconnect candidate adjacent to ABF substrates, with AI data-center exposure requiring verification through segment mix and customer/order evidence.

MKSI is a potentially underfollowed upstream equipment derivative for ABF/HDI substrate capacity expansion via ESI laser drilling, chemistry, and plating equipment; verify IC-substrate-specific order contribution.
AMKR is not an ABF substrate manufacturer but belongs in the US-listed universe as an advanced packaging and test provider whose AI/HPC package ramps depend on substrate/interconnect availability.

The most direct ABF substrate leaders are largely non-US-listed or OTC-accessible Asian companies, including Ibiden, Unimicron, Kinsus, and Nan Ya PCB; a separate non-US/OTC pass is required for the purest exposure.

node: ABF substrates and advanced PCB/interconnect for AI accelerators, CPUs, GPUs, and advanced packages
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around ABF substrates and advanced interconnect using a two-lane funnel. The direct ABF substrate leaders are mostly Japan/Taiwan-listed or OTC, so the US-listed direct-exposure set is mostly adjacent: AI accelerator customers, advanced PCB/interconnect manufacturers, advanced packaging users, and process-equipment suppliers for HDI/IC-substrate manufacturing. Reference anchor: NVIDIA as the dominant AI accelerator demand source. Underfollowed lane: TTM Technologies, MKS Instruments, and Amkor Technology as US-listed second-order beneficiaries tied to advanced PCBs, laser drilling/chemistry tools, and advanced package assembly/test.
